items.exampleEn: One question on the test was ambiguous, so the teacher gave everyone the point.
items.exampleZh: 考卷上有一題模稜兩可，所以老師給每個人那一分。

items.exampleEn: He looked puzzled by the strange noise from the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 廚房傳來的怪聲讓他一臉困惑。

items.exampleEn: The rainy weather affected ice cream sales negatively.
items.exampleZh: 下雨天對冰淇淋的銷量造成負面影響。

items.exampleEn: My parents gave me contradictory advice about which school to choose.
items.exampleZh: 關於要選哪所學校，我爸媽給我的建議互相矛盾。

items.exampleEn: Nobody could foresee how popular the game would become.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人預料得到那款遊戲會變得這麼受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: Her cooking skills are proven; she has won three contests.
items.exampleZh: 她的廚藝是經過證實的，她贏過三次比賽。

items.exampleEn: Getting angry at a computer is irrational.
items.exampleZh: 對電腦發脾氣是不理性的。

items.exampleEn: Please don't misunderstand me; I like your idea.
items.exampleZh: 請別誤會，我很喜歡你的點子。

items.sentenceEn: It's irrational to worry about things you can't change.
items.sentenceZh: 為改變不了的事擔心是不理性的。

items.audioEn: We didn't foresee the heavy traffic, so we arrived an hour late.
items.audioZh: 我們沒料到交通那麼塞，所以晚了一個小時才到。
options: They went to the wrong place first
They didn't expect the busy roads

items.sentenceEn: Many people misunderstand what my job really is.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人誤解了我的工作到底在做什麼。

items.sentenceEn: The new rule was viewed negatively by most students.
items.sentenceZh: 大多數學生對新規定的看法都很負面。

items.stemEn: The two reports were ____: one said the river was clean, and the other said it was dirty.
items.stemZh: 這兩份報告互相矛盾：一份說河水很乾淨，另一份說很髒。

items.stemEn: It is a ____ fact that the earth goes around the sun.
items.stemZh: 地球繞著太陽轉，是已經證實的事實。

items.passageEn: For our science project, we tested whether music helps plants grow. Two plants listened to music every day, but the results were contradictory: one grew fast, while the other hardly grew at all. We were puzzled until we noticed that the sunlight in the room was uneven. We had not foreseen that one window got much more sun. Our teacher said that two plants had not proven anything, and that we should test twenty next time. Some classmates misunderstood our poster and thought we said music was bad for plants, because the title was ambiguous. Even so, nobody reacted negatively, and the teacher liked our honest report.
items.passageZh: 我們的科學專題是測試音樂能不能幫助植物生長。兩盆植物每天都聽音樂，但結果互相矛盾：一盆長得很快，另一盆幾乎沒長。我們一直想不通，直到發現房間裡的陽光照得不平均。我們事先沒料到其中一扇窗戶的陽光多很多。老師說，只用兩盆植物什麼也證明不了，下次應該測二十盆。有些同學誤會了我們的海報，以為我們說音樂對植物不好，因為標題寫得模稜兩可。即使如此，沒有人給負面的反應，老師也很喜歡我們誠實的報告。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼兩盆植物長得不一樣？
options: 房間裡的陽光照得不平均
一盆植物的音樂開得比較大聲

questions.questionZh: 為什麼有些同學誤會了海報的意思？
options: 老師講錯了報告的重點
海報上的字小到幾乎看不清楚

items.promptZh: 我妹妹很怕打雷，雖然她知道這不理性。
referenceEn: My sister's fear of thunder is irrational, and she knows it.
My sister knows that her fear of thunder is irrational.
rubricZh: irrational 的用法，例如 is irrational、an irrational fear 等
時態合理（例如 is、knows 等）

items.promptZh: 她誤會了我說的話，以為我不高興。
referenceEn: She misunderstood what I said and thought I was upset.
She misunderstood my words and thought that I was unhappy.
rubricZh: 時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 misunderstood what I said、has misunderstood me 等）
「不高興」可寫，例如 upset、unhappy、angry 等
後半句時態配合前半句（例如 thought I was upset、thinks I'm upset 等）
